description: The file 'App.tsx' serves as the main React component for a mobile Ludo game app. It manages game state, player setup, game flow, UI rendering of the game board, dice, move logs, and persistence with local storage.

methods.name: randomDice
methods.description: Generates a random number between 1 and 6, simulating a dice roll.

methods.name: startNewGame
methods.description: Initializes a new game state based on selected players, resets last dice, and stores the state.

methods.name: resetToSetup
methods.description: Resets the app to the initial player setup screen, with a confirmation alert.

methods.name: onRollDice
methods.description: Handles dice rolling: sets rolling state, generates dice value, updates game state after delay.

methods.name: onSelectMove
methods.description: Applies a selected move, advances turn, and updates game state accordingly.

methods.name: updatePlayer
methods.description: Updates a player's configuration, such as name or active status.

methods.name: restoreSaved
methods.description: Loads a saved game from storage and restores it into the current state.
